data.external.ase_ilb_ip already has an implicit dependency on azurerm_template_deployment.ase (its `program` interpolates `lookup(azurerm_template_deployment.ase.outputs, "id")`), so the extra `depends_on = [azurerm_template_deployment.ase]` duplicates the ordering.

azurerm_private_dns_a_record.a_records already depends implicitly on data.external.ase_ilb_ip (it uses `data.external.ase_ilb_ip.result.internalIpAddress` in `records`), and that data source already depends on azurerm_template_deployment.ase. The explicit `depends_on = [azurerm_template_deployment.ase]` is therefore transitively redundant.

null_resource.grant_admin_consent already references azuread_service_principal.app.id (implicit dependency via `principalId = azuread_service_principal.app.id`), so `depends_on = [azuread_service_principal.app]` is redundant.

azurerm_site_recovery_replication_policy.policy references azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault.name (implicit dependency), so `depends_on = [azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault]` duplicates the ordering.
azurerm_express_route_gateway.er_gateway references azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id (implicit dependency), so `depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub]` is redundant.
azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway references azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id (implicit dependency), so the `depends_on` entry on azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub is redundant.

azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway references azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration[0].id (implicit dependency), so the `depends_on` entry on azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration is redundant.
azurerm_vpn_gateway.s2s_gateway references azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id (implicit dependency), so `depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub]` is redundant.

module.synapse_workspaces creates azurerm_key_vault_secret resources (sql_admin_password, sql_admin, synapse_name, synapse_rg_name) against the keyvault, but unlike the equivalent mssql_servers/virtual_machines/azuread_applications/azuread_users modules it has no ordering dependency on module.keyvault_access_policies. Writing secrets can fail before the deploying identity's keyvault access policy exists, so it should depend on the access policies module.
